name: SSH brute force succeeds on bastion01 while the log service is flapping
description: 240 failed password attempts against bastion01 followed by an accepted login for svc-backup, a shell, and a reverse connection. The log indexer returns 503 for the first two searches (tool failure); the agent retries, falls back to flow metadata, then resumes. bastion01 is a critical asset, so the block needs analyst approval. Correct outcome: SUCCEEDED, block 203.0.113.140, escalate for a credential reset.
